title: Researchers and educators unite for third year of NSF-funded writing intensive
summary_en: For three days this summer, teachers and IU researchers and faculty came together to create resources that will be used in classrooms during the school year. It’s the third year for the writing intensive called Hearing Each Other’s Voices, funded by a grant from the National Science Foundation.
